name: Spit Poison (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Poison (bite), Ability Focus (poison)

Benefit(s): You can spit your venom up to 30 feet as a standard action. This is a ranged touch attack with no range increment. Opponents hit by this attack must make successful saves against your poison as if it were a contact poison.
